ideas.text: An AI podcast producer that removes all silence, breathing, and sincerity from your interviews.
A content repurposing engine that transforms one tweet into a webinar, a course, and an emotionally vacant ebook.
An influencer copilot that generates apology videos before you have done anything wrong, just to stay ahead of the cycle.
An app that detects when your side hustle has spent more on a logo than it has earned in revenue.
A tool that flags when your side project's Stripe dashboard hasn't moved in 4 months.
An AI that converts your Substack subscriber count into the percentage who actually open it.
A bot that detects when you've called your side hustle a 'business' before it has had a customer.
An app that translates 'building in public' into 'I would like attention while I work.'
A tool that detects when you've branded your hobby and registered an LLC for it in the same week.
An AI that converts your domain purchases this year into the projects you actually shipped.
A bot that flags when 'I'm bootstrapping' is being used to mean 'I have not started yet.'
An app that detects when your newsletter intro is longer than the actual content.
A tool that translates 'soft launch' into the specific 4 friends you told.
